audit_sample.purpose: visual audit; not the reported accuracy
audit_sample.design: stratified random, without replacement; training pixels excluded
audit_sample.wording: Audit sample for visual checking: stratified by reference class with equal allocation; estimates are area-weighted by reference-class proportions (Olofsson et al. 2014). The census metrics are the reported accuracy.

multiclass.reason: Current FIRRIS classifiers are binary; no multiclass labels inferred

independent_calibration.reason: Requires independently reviewed observations and calibration evidence

validation_dashboard.scope: Internal agreement with SAR screening labels — not independent flood-map accuracy. Held-out pixels only (n = 1500).
limitations: Metrics describe supplied paired observations only; no independent certification, calibration or forecast skill is inferred.
Threshold sweeps are descriptive operating points; no safety threshold or optimal policy is selected.

reference_basis.statement: Internal agreement with SAR screening labels — not independent flood-map accuracy.
reference_basis.label_source: SAR screening pseudo-label; not independent ground truth
reference_basis.rule: label = (sar_change_db <= -1.5 dB) AND (slope < 15 deg) AND (JRC occurrence < 90%; never-water = 0% within Metadata valid_obs > 0)
reference_basis.split_method: stratified random sampling and pixel split (train fraction 0.7); test pixels come from the same scene and are interleaved with training pixels, so they are not spatially independent

scopes.title: Accuracy assessment against an independent Sentinel-2 optical reference
scopes.reference_basis: Sentinel-2 optical flood reference (MNDWI change, JRC permanent water excluded); not a model input; not field-verified
scopes.roc_auc_note: binary classifier; micro/macro ROC not applicable
scopes.interval_note: census of all eligible pixels: no sampling error, so no sampling interval

scopes.title: Internal agreement with SAR screening labels — not independent flood-map accuracy (held-out pixels)
scopes.reference_basis: SAR screening pseudo-label; not independent ground truth
scopes.roc_auc_note: binary classifier; micro/macro ROC not applicable
scopes.interval_note: percentile bootstrap over the held-out sample

accuracy_assessment.independent_wording: Accuracy assessment against an independent Sentinel-2 optical reference: census of n = 106088 eligible pixels not used for training. Not field-verified.

headline.text: Model-classified flood candidates cover 5.34 km² (5.44% of the 98.21 km² valid analysed area) for target 2024-05-24 to 2024-05-26, compared with baseline 2022-08-28 to 2022-09-03 (end dates exclusive). Flood candidates are a model classification trained on SAR screening labels, not confirmed flood observations.

area_accounting.method_note: AOI and excluded areas are estimated as cell counts × mean valid-cell area; a cell can be missing in several bands, so band counts overlap and do not add up.

quality_gates.threshold: one orbit, same in both periods

quality_gates.name: Daily rainfall completeness
quality_gates.threshold: every day of the target window

quality_gates.name: Independent reference
quality_gates.threshold: compliant Sentinel-2 at both dates; ≥ 50 eligible pixels per class

mndwi.role: independent accuracy reference only; not a model feature

optical_reference_policy.definition: flooded (1) = MNDWI > 0 on the target composite AND MNDWI <= 0 on the baseline composite AND JRC occurrence < 90%; not flooded (0) = every other eligible pixel
optical_reference_policy.mndwi: (B3 - B11) / (B3 + B11), Sentinel-2 SR harmonized, SCL cloud/shadow/cirrus/snow masked, median composite
optical_reference_policy.scene_policy: cloud <= max_cloud_pct and degraded MSI <= 0.1% (query filter + per-scene assertion), both periods; SCL class 1 and cloud classes masked per pixel
optical_reference_policy.eligibility: admitted pixels whose optical bands are valid at both dates
optical_reference_policy.independence: optical indices are not model features; the reference never enters the feature matrix
limitations: Optical water misses flooded vegetation and water under cloud
Reference restricted to pixels cloud-free at both dates
Reference and classifier observe slightly different dates

optical_mask.policy: no-data, defective, shadow, cloud, cirrus, snow/ice excluded
